title: Dad Did Nap
lines: Dad is on a mat. Dad did nap.
Sam did tap Dad. Tap, tap, tap.
Dad did nap. Sam is sad.
Sam did tip a tin pot.
Pop! The pot did tip on the mat.
Dad did sit! Dad is not mad.
No nap. Sam is not sad.

questions.listenFor: A tin pot. The story says it, so if your child is stuck, point to that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why did Dad finally sit up?
questions.listenFor: Because the pot tipped and went pop. You want the pot, not just "because he woke up." If they say "the noise," ask "what made the noise?"

questions.ask: Do you think Dad should have gotten up sooner? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason tied to the story - Sam was sad, or Dad was tired. The reason matters more than the answer.
